Food & issue taxonomy

Browse a normalized hierarchy of Oil and Ghee evidence

Broad categories organize normalized concepts while preserving original model terms as aliases. The hierarchy covers food products, issue types, adulterants, claim status, regulatory actions, supply-chain stages, detection methods and ontology relationships.

Counts describe this model extraction release. They are not official prevalence estimates and do not imply that every unresolved triplet is a validated ontology mapping.
